MMS Protocol A - Basic

Protocol mms miracle-mineral-solution sodium-chlorite citric-acid activated

Evidence: Grade C (traditional_use)

Summary

MMS basic protocol using sodium chlorite activated with citric acid.

Indications

  • general-wellness
  • antimicrobial-support
  • detoxification

Contraindications

  • pregnancy
  • kidney-disease
  • severe-heart-conditions
  • bleeding-disorders

Dosage

1 drop activated MMS solution mixed in water, increase gradually as tolerated

Frequency: 1-3 times daily
